summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation across inventory and orders modules, ensuring atomic stock reservation, priority-based order processing, idempotent order IDs, and strict input immutability.

requirements.description: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be aggregated before stock validation.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: A warehouse stock state and an order containing multiple lines with possible duplicate SKUs
acceptance.then: SKU quantities are aggregated and subtracted atomically if sufficient stock exists, or no stock is consumed if any line is insufficient or unknown

requirements.description: Expedited orders must be allocated inventory before normal orders while preserving arrival order within each priority.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A list of orders with mixed expedited and normal priorities
acceptance.when: Orders are fulfilled against available warehouse inventory
acceptance.then: Valid expedited orders are processed in input order before valid normal orders are processed in input order

requirements.description: Order IDs are idempotent, processing only the first occurrence and ignoring subsequent duplicate order IDs.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: An incoming batch of orders containing repeated order IDs
acceptance.then: The first occurrence claims the order ID and any subsequent orders with the same ID are completely ignored

requirements.description: Invalid order lines and malformed orders must be rejected without mutating stock or any input arguments.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Stock mappings and orders with invalid lines or invalid structure
acceptance.when: Stock reservation or order fulfillment is invoked
acceptance.then: Rejected orders do not alter inventory levels and the caller original input objects remain strictly unmutated

assumptions: Stock levels are non-negative safe integers mapped by non-empty SKU strings.
Order line quantities are positive safe integers.
First occurrences of orders with invalid priority are rejected as invalid_order and still claim their ID.
Orders with missing or invalid IDs are rejected with id: null and reason: invalid_order without claiming an ID.
